title: Engineering Cellular Metabolism with Nitric Oxide Sensing and Proteolytic Control
summary: This cluster focuses on the intersection of cellular metabolism engineering and nitric oxide sensing. D.J. Gibbs' work is mediated by nitric oxide sensing, while Keasling JD and Nielsen J used their methods to engineer cellular metabolism. Proteolytic control regulates group VII erf transcription factors, and integrative analysis, performed by T.A. Lee, is involved in the epigenome. The cluster also includes various gene and protein entities, such as ERFVII families and molecular oxygen, which are used by aerobic organisms.
